identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Pemetrexed, Carboplatin and Bevacizumab in Participants With Nonsquamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Randomized, Open-Label, Phase 3 Study of Pemetrexed Plus Carboplatin and Bevacizumab Followed by Maintenance Pemetrexed and Bevacizumab Versus Paclitaxel Plus Carboplatin and Bevacizumab Followed by Maintenance Bevacizumab in Patients With Stage IIIB or IV Nonsquamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

armGroups.label: Pem/Carbo/Bev
armGroups.description: Pemetrexed (Pem), carboplatin (Carbo) and bevacizumab (Bev) followed by pemetrexed and bevacizumab

armGroups.label: Pac/Carbo/Bev
armGroups.description: Paclitaxel (Pac), carboplatin (Carbo) and bevacizumab (Bev) followed by bevacizumab

interventions.name: Pemetrexed
interventions.description: Induction therapy 500 milligram per meter squared (mg/m\^2) intravenously (IV) every 21 days (with carboplatin and bevacizumab) for up to 4 cycles of 21 days

interventions.name: Pemetrexed
interventions.description: Maintenance therapy 500 mg/m\^2 IV every 21 days (with bevacizumab) until progressive disease or treatment discontinuation

interventions.name: Paclitaxel
interventions.description: Induction therapy 200 mg/m\^2 IV every 21 days (with carboplatin and bevacizumab) for up to 4 cycles of 21 days

interventions.name: Carboplatin
interventions.description: Induction therapy area under the concentration curve (AUC) 6 IV every 21 days for up to 4 cycles of 21 days

interventions.name: Bevacizumab
interventions.description: Induction therapy 15 milligrams per kilogram (mg/kg) IV every 21 days for up to 4 cycles of 21 days

interventions.name: Bevacizumab
interventions.description: Maintenance therapy 15 mg/kg IV every 21 days until progressive disease or treatment discontinuation.
